same_start: equivalent beds, blocks, prices, notes, and time assumptions
matched model/provider/settings where possible without changing Classic
invalidate_pair_if: unrelated shared staging activity changes the fingerprinted inventory or Pricing
never: restore the shared database to reset a test
let one version's hold starve the other
train on or rewrite these scripts after seeing a failure

completion.rule: v3 completes every applicable step of all five scenarios in every repeat, without operator rescue
completion.failure_paths_pass_by: not writing, and explaining the situation correctly, not by forcing a booking

needs_all: at least one predeclared guest-outcome improvement
blind majority preference for v3 clarity and naturalness across the five paired scenarios
beats_classic.latency_and_cost: reported, not hidden inside the quality score

capture_each_run: final booking, bed, payment, and transfer state
separate_probes: two v3 sessions competing for the same beds
v3 versus the existing Staff write path competing for the same beds
